question_text: Explain how using a VPN can help a museum curator access an internal catalogue while travelling on untrusted Wi-Fi.
adaptation_rationale: VPN is explicitly listed countermeasure; explain protection and its limit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Authenticated VPN creates an encrypted tunnel to the museum, protecting traffic on public Wi-Fi and allowing authorized access to the internal catalogue.

marking_points.criterion: Connects private access to internal catalogue while remote.
